messages:
jordyn: Postmortem follow-up from yesterday's cross-region TLS flap. Action items below, assigning owners. TL;DR: transient SNI mismatch + route churn caused retries in region-b; fallback to older cert bundle helped but we saw cascading retry storm.
samir: thanks — timeline?
jordyn: Initial regression 03:14 UTC, spike 03:14-03:22, mitigated 03:28 after rollback. Root cause: cert rollout + routing rule race; reproducer in staging when we roll LB config + certs.
mike: i can own config rollback automation. will draft PR by EOD. /cc @talia for observability changes
talia: I'll add a new trace span and a fallback metric: routing.fallback.invocations and an alert at rate>0.5% over 5m. also propose synthetic test hitting region-b every 2m.
samir: who will own followups for kv-cache invalidation? appears to interact with prefix caching.
jordyn: assigning @mike to config automation, @talia for metrics + probes, @samir for cache invalidation investigation. timeline: config automation 3d, probes + alerts 2d, cache investigation 4d. Can we get owners to update Jira tickets with steps and acceptance criteria?
mike: creating JIRA INF-4821 with checklist. Acceptance: automated rollback triggers on cert rollout failure + runbook updated. ETA 72h. :thumbsup:
talia: INF-4822 for observability. Acceptance: new metric, dashboard, alert, and synthetic probe green in staging for 48h. ETA 48h.
samir: INF-4823 for cache. I'll start a bisect to see when kv eviction misaligns with routing. ETA 96h. Note: might need infra time to reproduce.
jordyn: good. also action: add per-route cert version tagging in LB so we can drill down quickly. who can do that?
mike: i'll add tagging to rollout tool, small change. PR tomorrow morning.
talia: in meantime, add a temporary dashboard panel: `sum(rate(routing_fallback_total[5m])) by (region)`
samir: one more: we saw retries spike due to TCP conn reuse across AZs. File infrastructure ticket for sticky sessions config review.
jordyn: adding INF-4824 for sticky session review, assign to @elaine (networking). @elaine can you ack?
elaine: ack, will triage and propose stickiness policy — ETA 72h.
deploy-bot: deploys: rolled back cert bundle to v1.8.3 at 03:28 UTC; automated rollback triggered: true
jordyn: next check-in tomorrow 16:00 UTC. If anyone needs to reassign, mention here. Also include any logs or repro steps. paste minimal repro: `curl -H 'Host: api.redwood.ai' --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:10.0.2.5 https://api.redwood.ai/health`
mike: FYI I'll need a window of low traffic to test rollback automation—ping infra for maintenance window.
talia: I'll create the dashboard in Grafana and share link once done.
samir: noting potential recurring pattern: cert rollouts + routing churn during canary windows. we should consider staging rollout first per region.
jordyn: :white_check_mark: agreed, adding that to rollout playbook. Thanks all.
